with ALLOWED_ORIGIN='https://a.example,https://b.example' both origins are allowed and a third is not, pinned by a test in backend/tests/
the TODO(user) comment and module docstring in backend/app/main.py name the new default and no longer say the default is *

spec.outcome: backend/app/main.py defaults ALLOWED_ORIGIN to https://rd.beam-stack.com instead of *, so an unset variable fails closed; local dev sets it explicitly
